description: This file defines the TransactionService class, which manages Transaction objects, providing methods to retrieve all transactions and create new ones.

classes.name: TransactionService
classes.description: A service class for managing transactions, providing methods to find all transactions and create new transactions.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns the list of all transactions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Transaction with the specified amount, date, and references, adds it to the transaction list, and returns it.
